name: Staff of the Woodlands
description: A living staff of oak that still sprouts leaves in spring.
body:
## What it does

It fights as a magic quarterstaff that strikes truer and harder than a plain one, and your spell attacks strike truer. Its charges speak to beasts and plants and wake the woods, and you can always pass through them without a trace.

## Tree form

Planted in fertile earth for a charge, it becomes a great tree, and a staff again when you touch it and speak.

## Charges

It holds ten and regains 1d6 + 4 each dawn. Spend the last and it may become a plain staff.

features.name: Tree Form
features.text: As an action and 1 charge, plant it in fertile earth to become a 60-foot tree until you touch it and speak again.

charges.last: roll a d20; on a 1 it becomes a nonmagical quarterstaff
